title: Apply lens formula

hook.scenario: Aap ek magnifying glass se chiti (ant) ko dekh rahe ho. Agar glass ko chiti se 5cm door rakho, toh image kahan aur kitni door banegi?
hook.question: Lens ke through banne wali image ki exact location mathematical form mein kaise nikalein?

mental_model.intuition: Mirror formula ka judwa bhai, bas ek minus sign ka farq.
mental_model.description: Lens formula (1/v - 1/u = 1/f) object distance, image distance, aur focal length ko connect karta hai. Mirror formula mein beech mein plus (+) hota tha, yahan minus (-) hai.

explanation:
Lens formula physics mein light ka sabse important mathematical tool hai. Yeh humein batata hai ki agar humein f aur u pata hain, toh image kahan (v) banegi. 

Formula hai: 1/v - 1/u = 1/f

Yahan:
- v = image distance
- u = object distance
- f = focal length

Is formula ko use karte waqt 2 cheezein bahut carefully karni hoti hain. Pehli: har value ko sign convention ke sath daalna (+ ya -). Agar u = -10cm hai, toh formula ban jata hai 1/v - (1/-10) = 1/f, jo solve hone par 1/v + 1/10 ban jayega. Yeh minus-minus ki galti sabse aam hai.

Doosri baat: Jab aap solve kar rahe hote ho, toh finally aapko 1/v ki value milti hai (jaise 1/v = 1/15). Wahi par answer mat chod dena! Aapko fraction ko palatna (reciprocal) hoga, tab jaa kar v ki final value aayegi (v = 15 cm).

Signs ka dhyan hamesha rakhein. Agar solve karte waqt 'v' positive (+ve) aata hai, toh samajh lijiye image lens ke right side mein bani hai (Real and inverted). Agar 'v' negative aata hai, toh image left side mein bani hai (Virtual and erect).

key_points.title: Don't Forget the Reciprocal
key_points.detail: Always invert the final fraction. If 1/v = 2/30, then v = 30/2 = 15 cm.

worked_example.problem: An object is placed 15 cm in front of a concave lens of focal length 30 cm. Find the image position.

steps.narration: Values ko signs ke saath likhein. Concave lens ka f negative hota hai.
1/15 ko right side mein shift karein.

worked_example.answer: Image is formed 10 cm in front of the lens (virtual).

worked_example.problem: A convex lens of focal length 10 cm forms a real image at 20 cm. Find the object distance.

steps.narration: Signs pehchanein: convex ka f + hota hai, aur real image ka v +.
1/u nikalne ke liye equation rearrange karein.

common_mistakes.title: Using mirror formula by mistake
common_mistakes.explanation: Exam ke pressure mein bache 1/v + 1/u = 1/f likh dete hain. Lens mein (-) lagta hai, yaad rakhne ka tareeka: LENS mein 'Less' jaisa minus hai.

recall_questions.q: If solving gives 1/v = -1/5, what is the value of v?
What is the lens formula relating object distance, image distance, and focal length?

oa_questions.question: A concave lens of focal length 15 cm forms an image 10 cm from the lens. How far is the object placed from the lens?
oa_questions.approach: f = -15 cm, v = -10 cm (since concave lens always forms virtual image on the same side). 1/u = 1/v - 1/f.

oa_questions.question: A convex lens forms a real image at 40 cm. If f = 20 cm, find the object distance.
oa_questions.approach: Use lens formula 1/v - 1/u = 1/f, put v = +40 and f = +20.
